site: https://reservations.explora.com/ (302 -> /ibe/paso1). Art2Fly IBE, server-rendered PHP-style pages on nginx/1.30.2. Every step is a full page load (window.__mark lost); only nights loading is AJAX.

framework.select2: 4.0.13 loaded but not applied to these selects
framework.third_party: GTM GTM-WVCWG8, GA/gtag, Facebook pixel, Clarity, Bing UET, LinkedIn, Sojern, Ensighten, CallTrackingMetrics (rewrites phone numbers), OptinMonster api, Asksuite pixel (no chat widget seen), Sirdata consentframework CMP (no banner shown in our session)

language.cookie: lang=EN|ES (path=/, 1 year, set by server on first visit)
language.switch: No language UI on this subdomain. Use query ?language=ES or ?language=EN (uppercase; sticky for the browser session) or set cookie lang=ES. ?lang=ES and lowercase ?language=es do nothing.
language.note: Expedition page title (e.g. ICELAND EXPEDITION) stays English in ES; hotel labels translate (e.g. 'Torres del Paine - Reserva de Conservacion, Chile').

hotels.label: Torres del Paine - Conservation Reserve, Chile

nationalities.label: Congo, The Democratic Republic of the
South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands

nationalities_notes: 244 options incl. blank first. Same list on the expeditions form and paso3. Duplicate values: 'AL' = Albania AND 'Congo, The Democratic Republic of the' (select by value gives Albania); 'FR' and 'FX' are both 'France'. Use 'US' United States, 'GB' Great Britain, 'IN' India, 'CL' Chile.

steps.title: Reservations In Explora hotels. Best Expedition Company
steps.heading: PLEASE PROVIDE YOUR TRAVEL DETAILS

fields.name: hotel_code
fields.label: 1. Select HOTEL / TRAVESIA

options.label: Torres del Paine - Conservation Reserve, Chile

fields.notes: Inline onchange="this.form.action='paso1'; submit();" -> any change does a FULL PAGE RELOAD to /ibe/paso1?...&hotel_code=X, which repaints the calendar with that hotel's availability (lista_disponibles). Expedition codes (X*) return 302 -> /ibe/expeditions?expedition_request=X. Setting the value with the native setter + dispatching 'change' fires the inline handler; a plain .value= without the event does not reload.

fields.name: check_in_date
fields.label: 2. SELECT ARRIVAL DATE
fields.selector: #check_in_date (hidden input, altField) + #check_in_calendar (inline jQuery UI datepicker span)
fields.notes: Format yy-mm-dd (2026-11-06). Hidden so jQuery Validate ignores it (default ignore ':hidden'); it is pre-filled with tomorrow. Server-side value is what counts.

fields.name: nights
fields.label: 3. Select the number of nights of your stay
fields.notes: Populated by AJAX GET /ibe/get_stay?dt=YYYY-MM-DD&hc=CODE&session_id= (JSON [{nights,amount,currency,recommended_stay?}]). Option value = nights int, label '5 nights (from US$ 1,140 / night )'. The recommended_stay item is auto-selected. Observed ranges: EATA 3-6 or 3-8 depending on date. [{"nights":0}] => single 'Not available' option with value 0. Site copy: 'programs two nights or longer'. Validation message 'Required Field'. No adults/children/rooms on paso1.

buttons.notes: jQuery Validate submitHandler disables it 3 s then form.submit() -> GET /ibe/paso2?session_id=&hotel_code=..&check_in_date=..&nights=..

Each room is its own GET form to add_room; a global jQuery(document).submit handler opens /ibe/add_room?... in a Magnific Popup iframe. Popup has 'I'm ready. Go to check-out' (button.checkout, POST paso3), 'Add more rooms', 'Add another Explora destination'.

steps.title: Contact info

fields.name: firstname
fields.notes: minlength 2, letters only /^[a-zA-Z\s]*$/ (accents rejected!). Msg 'Please enter your first name'

steps.notes: This is the paid-booking path (paso4 payment, paso5 confirmation). NOT the enquiry form; never submit. No reCAPTCHA here.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.notes: No value attrs; value == text. Defaults to Mr.

fields.name: email
fields.label: Email
fields.notes: type=email => jQuery Validate adds email rule: 'Please enter a valid email address.'

fields.name: phone
fields.label: Phone
fields.notes: plain text, no format rule, no country-code widget; '+1 555 0100' accepted

validation.library: jQuery Validate, rules all required:true, no submitHandler
validation.error_element: label.error inserted after the field (inside .control-value); .control-value gets class error/success

datepicker.library: jQuery UI 1.14.1 Datepicker, INLINE (always visible), on span#check_in_calendar.hasDatepicker; altField #check_in_date
datepicker.options: firstDay 1 (Mon), minDate 1 (today not selectable), maxDate 2029-01-31, numberOfMonths 2 at >=639px (1 below), beforeShowDay revisa_dispo
datepicker.availability: window.lista_disponibles = array of 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings rendered server-side for the selected hotel (empty with no hotel => all days disabled). Available: td.ui-state-highlight.input_ok[data-handler=selectDay] > a[data-date]. Unavailable: td.ui-datepicker-unselectable.ui-state-disabled.input_error > span. data-month is 0-based.
datepicker.navigation: #check_in_calendar .ui-datepicker-next / .ui-datepicker-prev (prev has ui-state-disabled at first month). Month titles: #check_in_calendar .ui-datepicker-title.
datepicker.how_to_pick: Real click: click td[data-handler=selectDay][data-month=M0][data-year=Y] a[data-date=D] (navigate with .ui-datepicker-next first). onSelect empties #nights, shows 'Please wait...', calls getStay(date) -> AJAX fills #nights. Programmatic (no clicks): check lista_disponibles.includes(d); $('#check_in_calendar').datepicker('setDate', d) (updates altField + highlights, jumps view) THEN getStay(d) yourself, because setDate does not fire onSelect; wait until $('#nights').val() !== ''. Setting #check_in_date.value alone does nothing visible and nights stay empty.
datepicker.deep_link_prefill: /ibe/paso1?hotel_code=EATA&check_in_date=2026-11-06 preselects hotel and date (calendar shows that month) but nights is NOT loaded; call getStay('2026-11-06') or click the day.

recaptcha.version: v2 checkbox ('I'm not a robot', size=normal)
recaptcha.challenge_iframe: iframe[src*='recaptcha/api2/bframe'] inside a fixed full-screen div (z-index 2000000000, visibility hidden until a challenge)
recaptcha.script: https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api.js (no render param, no data-callback; YourOnSubmitFn defined but unused)
recaptcha.unchecked_behavior: Click Send: button stays enabled; jQuery Validate blocks the submit and shows label.error 'This field is required.' for hiddenRecaptcha just above the widget (plus any other empty fields). No request is sent.
recaptcha.agent_rule: The visitor must tick the checkbox themselves. Agent fills fields, scrolls #c_recaptcha into view, asks the visitor to tick it, waits for grecaptcha.getResponse() !== '' and then clicks Send.

submit.method: POST form-urlencoded, full page navigation to the same URL /ibe/expeditions?expedition_request=X (not AJAX). Fields: expedition_name, expedition_id, title, firstname, lastname, email, phone, country, message, hiddenRecaptcha, g-recaptcha-response.
submit.how: document.querySelector('#form-expeditions button[type=submit]').click() (or .requestSubmit()); never form.submit(), which skips validation. Pre-check with $('#form-expeditions').valid().
submit.not_tested: Actual send was NOT performed (hard rule); post-submit page unknown.

deep_links.from_www: All lodge pages' CHECK AVAILABILITY / Book now -> https://reservations.explora.com/ibe/paso1?language=EN (no hotel). Sacred Mountains page links https://reservations.explora.com/ibe/expeditions?expedition_request=XSCM. Expeditions hub uses mailto:reserveexpeditions@explora.com and /contact-expedition-expert.

working_params./ibe/paso1?hotel_code=CODE: preselects hotel and loads its availability
working_params./ibe/paso1?hotel_code=CODE&check_in_date: also preselects date (nights still needs getStay)
working_params./ibe/expeditions?expedition_request=CODE: enquiry form for that expedition (unknown code => 200 with empty heading)

deep_links.not_supported: Contact fields cannot be prefilled by query string (firstname/email/message ignored).

headers.all_steps: paso1, paso2, add_room, paso3, expeditions: no Content-Security-Policy, no CSP-Report-Only, no Permissions-Policy, no X-Frame-Options, no HSTS seen. Headers: cache-control max-age=0,no-cache; content-type text/html; server nginx/1.30.2; vary Accept-Encoding,User-Agent; set-cookie browser_id, lang.
headers.mediaDevices: navigator.mediaDevices and getUserMedia exist (https, no Permissions-Policy restriction)
headers.fetch_to_voqalize: Not blocked by the page (no CSP; fetch to example.com no-cors worked). fetch('https://app.dev.voqalize.com/') failed only because of OUR response headers (no Access-Control-Allow-Origin; Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin). A CORS-enabled Voqalize API endpoint, or calls from the extension background/service worker, will work.

layout.fixed_headers: none; <header> is position:relative (top phone bar #header-top, #header-logo, #steps breadcrumb all scroll away)
layout.overlays: No cookie banner and no chat widget rendered in our sessions (Sirdata CMP and Asksuite pixel load, may appear by geo). Only fixed element: reCAPTCHA challenge backdrop (hidden). Magnific Popup (.mfp-wrap/.mfp-content iframe) on paso2 when a room is added. Bottom-right is free.
layout.form_position: Expedition form is in #formulario-expeditions inside #expeditions (left column, ~800px wide), Send button ~y=1350 at 1440x900 so scroll needed.

recipes.choose_hotel: const s=document.querySelector('#destination'); set(s,'EATA'); // fires inline onchange -> full reload. Re-inject the agent after load.
recipes.pick_date: if(!lista_disponibles.includes(d)) -> tell visitor unavailable; else $('#check_in_calendar').datepicker('setDate',d); $('#nights').empty().append('<option value="">Please wait...</option>'); getStay(d); then poll $('#nights').val()!==''.
recipes.pick_nights: set(document.querySelector('#nights'), String(n)) only if an option with that value exists
recipes.fill_expedition: const f=document.querySelector('#form-expeditions'); set(f.title,'Ms.'); set(f.firstname,'Ana'); set(f.lastname,'Diaz'); set(f.email,'ana@example.com'); set(f.phone,'+1 415 555 0100'); set(f.country,'US'); set(f.message,'...'); $(f).validate().element(f.email);
recipes.press_send: if(grecaptcha.getResponse()===''){ask visitor to tick captcha} else document.querySelector('#form-expeditions button[type=submit]').click();
